source.prompt: (the barred owl's) A barred owl (Strix varia), one adult perched upright, side-on pose, wings folded against the body. Realistic proportions: 50 cm long, a big round head with NO ear tufts, a pale grey-brown facial disc with concentric dark rings, large dark brown eyes, a small yellow hooked bill, a stocky body, a medium tail. Grey-brown plumage with white bars across the back and wings, horizontal brown bars across the upper breast and vertical brown streaks on the pale belly; feathered legs and feet with dark talons. No base, no perch, no branch. Game-ready, clean closed mesh.

tiers.note: A variant of the barred owl's Meshy preview (no credits), scaled to 0.20 m tall, the head widened 1.22x (a big round head, no ear tufts); yellow eyes with black pupils as forward discs; a small black bill cone; feathered buff-white legs with dark talons; a 6 cm rounded brown tail with thin white bars (lod0), angled 36 degrees below level (raised from 55 to keep its tip off the ground). Colours: warm brown upperparts with white spots on the crown and back (whole faces, decided at each face centre; fine white streaks on the forehead rim); a white facial disc with brown radiating streaks (lod0 and lod1), brownish round the eyes, and a white Y between and over the eyes; white underparts with broad rusty-brown streaks; brown flight cards with rows of white spots (lod0). Triangles: lod0 1,199 = 856 body + 343 legs, tail, cards, eyes and bill; lod1 449 = 314 body + 135 legs, tail, cards, eyes and bill; lod2 140 = 92 body + 48 legs, tail, cards, eyes and bill. GLB 240,112 bytes. lod_m is a suggestion.

rig: bird rig template of the Steller's jay (tools/build_stellersjay.py; drawn with client/src/animalModels.js RIG.stjay's constants): PART BODY 0, LEG_A 1 / LEG_B 2 procedural legs (pivot at the knee), TAIL 3 procedural tail (pivot at the rump), HEAD 6 (head and neck, pivot at the base of the neck), WING_L/R 4/5 and HAND_L/R 9/10 flight cards that collapse into the shoulder on pose; extras.rig {kind 'bird', wing (shoulder), tail (rump), head (neck base), length_m}; no skin
accuracy_notes: Built 2026-11-05. Reads as a saw-whet: a big round tuftless head, a pale face with yellow eyes and a black bill, warm brown spotted white above, rusty streaks below. Still open: the crown spots are large faces, so the head looks more blotched than finely streaked; the back spots are faint (big faces take a spot weakened); the radiating streaks on the disc are soft; the upright model flies 'standing up' under RIG.stjay unless the client pitches it (as the barred owl).
